prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: 1536×1024 high-fidelity desktop enterprise web application decision comp
Primary request: Design a realistic Athena target-state desktop UI called “阶段对照图谱”. It must help software lifecycle roles compare how the same requirement REQ-142 evolves across five aligned testing stages: evidence understanding, test case design, test script implementation, execution verification, and diagnosis/improvement. Use the compositional discipline of an archival botanical folio—fixed-ratio plates, a shared baseline, registered overlays, graphite captions—but DO NOT depict plants, botanical illustrations, leaves, flowers, specimens, nature, or a decorative poster.
Product truth: Athena is a testing-centered intelligent work platform connecting requirements and project evidence to reviewable test cases, scripts, controlled execution, results, evidence, and diagnosis in one traceable chain. It is not a generic chatbot or a stack of unrelated dashboards. The design is a future target-state synthetic example and must not imply these capabilities already ship.
Scene/backdrop: A full desktop web app viewport, 1536×1024, viewed straight-on. Persistent product shell with a slim left rail, restrained top bar, and one dominant working canvas. The canvas resembles a serious archival comparison table/workbench translated into software UI, not paper collage.
Information architecture:
- Left rail: Athena wordmark; project switcher “支付结算平台”; compact navigation items “工作台”, “需求与证据”, “测试设计”, “脚本”, “执行”, “结果与诊断”; bottom role indicator “QA / SDET”.
- Top bar: breadcrumb “项目 / REQ-142 / 阶段对照图谱”; scope chip “目标态 · 合成示例” prominently visible; controls “对照版本”, “筛选”, and a subdued primary action “发起评审”.
- Main heading: “REQ-142 · 退款异常处理” with subtitle “同一需求在五个阶段的 revision 对齐”.
- Central hero: five fixed-proportion vertical plates aligned on one exact horizontal baseline and separated by narrow gutters. Stage headers must read verbatim: “01 证据理解”, “02 测试用例”, “03 脚本实现”, “04 执行验证”, “05 诊断改进”.
- Each plate is a real software surface with compact structured rows, stable object IDs, revision chips, state labels, and thin connector rules. Use these exact artifact anchors, one per stage: “REQ-142 · r03”, “TC-142.1 · r05”, “TS-142.1 · r04”, “RUN-142 · A02”, “RCA-142 · c01”.
- Show provenance and status without fabricated business metrics: citations “[S1] 需求规格 §4.2” and “[S2] API 契约 §7”; states such as “已核对”, “待评审”, “验证通过”, “候选建议”. Clearly distinguish facts, candidates, and verified results.
- Registered overlay interaction: the second and third plates have two subtly offset revision layers with registration corner marks; a horizontal overlay control below them reads “r04 ↔ r05” and “差异叠加”. Use thin red change marks and green verified marks, never decorative charting.
- A narrow right inspection drawer titled “Revision 对照” showing “REQ-142 · r03” and a compact semantic delta: “错误码: E409 → E422”, source reference, reviewer field, and buttons “接受候选” and “保留当前”. Make it clearly subordinate to the five-stage canvas.
- Bottom shared-baseline legend: “事实”, “候选”, “已验证”, with non-color visual markers and a short audit note “所有变更保留来源与 revision”.
Style/medium: shippable high-fidelity B2B SaaS product UI, editorial information design, precise archival folio discipline translated into modern enterprise software; no concept-art treatment. Calm, dense but legible, credible interaction affordances, 8px spacing logic, crisp 1px rules, square-to-soft 4–8px radii, restrained shadows only where required for revision overlays.
Composition/framing: landscape desktop viewport at 3:2 ratio. The five aligned plates are the unmistakable visual hero and occupy most of the canvas. Strong baseline alignment and fixed proportions. Full app chrome is visible. No browser frame, no device mockup, no external scene.
Color palette: parchment #F1E8D5 as the principal surface; deep umber #4B382A for graphite-like captions and rules; verified green #315C45; change/candidate red #A23B32. Maintain accessible contrast. No gradients.
Typography: crisp Chinese sans serif for UI labels paired with a restrained graphite-caption style for metadata; readable at normal desktop scale. Do not use calligraphy.
Text (verbatim, render carefully): “Athena”, “目标态 · 合成示例”, “阶段对照图谱”, “REQ-142 · 退款异常处理”, “同一需求在五个阶段的 revision 对齐”, “01 证据理解”, “02 测试用例”, “03 脚本实现”, “04 执行验证”, “05 诊断改进”, “REQ-142 · r03”, “TC-142.1 · r05”, “TS-142.1 · r04”, “RUN-142 · A02”, “RCA-142 · c01”, “Revision 对照”, “差异叠加”, “事实”, “候选”, “已验证”, “所有变更保留来源与 revision”.
Constraints: clearly show “目标态 · 合成示例”; realistic enterprise software rather than a poster; preserve one coherent trace from REQ-142 through all five stages; show fixed-ratio plates, common baseline annotations, and registered overlay discipline; do not invent customer names, testimonials, adoption numbers, pass rates, performance metrics, or business KPIs; no logos other than plain Athena text; no watermark.
Avoid: generic dashboard, generic AI chat, oversized metric cards, analytics dashboard, ordinary kanban, ancient Greece, Greek columns, helmets, owls, mythology, plants, flowers, leaves, botanical drawings, natural-history specimens, poster layout, paper scrapbook, gradients, glassmorphism, glossy 3D, neon, cyberpunk, excessive rounded cards, purple SaaS palette, stock photography.
